messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated p99/tail latency observed on streaming inference routes (v1/chat/stream, v1/generate) starting ~16:23 UTC. Symptoms: streaming stalls, long tails, intermittent 503s from control-plane auth DB and configfetch timeouts. Paging oncall.

Priya Nair: I'm on it, joining channel. trying to correlate traces.

Alex Chen: seeing p95 jump from ~420ms to ~1.2s, p99 spiking up to 6-8s for streaming tails. Non-streaming p99 also higher but fewer 5xx. Queues backing for inference edge.

Rory Patel: logs show repeated tokenstore DB errors: `context deadline exceeded` + `txn abort`. Configfetch calls spiking 500-504s. probable control-plane DB contention.

Marta Gomez: any immediate customer impact? support is getting messages about stalled streams.

Jamie Li: Support: two enterprise customers (ACME Corp, BetaApps) report stalled streaming sessions, some retries succeed, others time out. Estimate ~8-12% of streams affected.

Priya Nair: reproducing with curl -> streaming hangs after first token, then timeout after ~10s.

Alex Chen: snippet from control-plane logs:
```
2026-02-18T16:23:12Z controlplane tokenstore.go:142 error="context deadline exceeded" query="SELECT token FROM tokens WHERE ..."
2026-02-18T16:23:13Z configfetch service.go:87 warn="upstream timeout 1.5s"
```

Rory Patel: feature flag service is also showing elevated fanout and retries. suspect backoff/feature-flag poll caused extra load on token DB.

incident-bot: @oncall-eng pager triggered: Pager sent to Alex Chen and Rory Patel. Severity elevated to SEV2.

Alex Chen: Quick mitigation plan: 1) enable prefix KV cache for token lookups, 2) scale tokenstore deployment from 3 -> 6 replicas, 3) increase DB pool size temporarily, 4) revert recent flag backoff change. Applying now.

Marta Gomez: support notified customers: "We're investigating intermittent streaming stalls; no data loss. We'll provide ETA in 30 minutes." (ACME/BetaApps updated)

Jamie Li: I'm going to flip `feature.flag.auth_timeout_backoff` to off for 10m to stop configfetch fanout.

Priya Nair: Running rollout command: `kubectl -n controlplane set env deployment/tokenstore CACHE_MODE=prefix` and scaling: `kubectl scale deploy tokenstore --replicas=6`.

Alex Chen: rollout: 3/6 pods ready -> 5/6 -> one pod restarting due to transient OOM (likely burst). Increasing mem limits on that pod and continuing.

Rory Patel: Applied DB changes: increased max_connections, bumped pool to 120. Added index hint to token lookup query to reduce full scans.

incident-bot: AUTO: Canary for configfetch revert set for +10m; will auto-rollback if error rate > 2%.

Jamie Li: Observability update: p99 for streaming tails down from ~7s -> ~950ms after cache warmup and scaling. Still seeing some ~1.2-1.5s tails.

Alex Chen: warmup expected. Also enabling short-term fallback: route streaming requests for affected customer IDs to model-variant `small-latency` if latency > 3s to preserve UX.

Priya Nair: Found hotkey pattern in tokens table — small set of tokens causing heavy churn. Running query to evict stale tokens and apply TTL enforcement.

Rory Patel: Confirmed hotkeys causing DB contention. We'll add rate-windowing on configfetch and backpressure on token validations.

Marta Gomez: Support: added note to customers that mitigation in progress; offering dedicated retry window and workaround (non-streaming fallback) if they want.

Jamie Li: Summary for postmortem draft: root cause = sudden hotspot in token validation + feature-flag backoff change -> configfetch fanout -> DB contention -> tail latency and streaming stalls. Immediate mitigations: cache prefixing, scale tokenstore, DB pool increase, feature flag revert, fallback routing. Next actions: permanent token cache, query/index improvements, rate-windowing for configfetch, improve canary for feature flag changes.

Priya Nair: I'll own permanent cache + token query optimization. ETA 2 weeks for full rollout.

Rory Patel: I'll own DB tuning + rate-windowing on configfetch. Will prepare runbook updates.

Jamie Li: I'll draft customer postmortem and internal incident report. Will include SLO impacts, affected customers, timeline and mitigations.

Alex Chen: nice work everyone. leaving channel for handoff to Rory at 18:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident moved to monitoring at 17:11 UTC. Last automated update posted. Handoff scheduled to Rory Patel at 18:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
